title: Stateless web tier
purpose: Show horizontally scalable interchangeable web nodes with external shared session state, retaining application cache/DB/CDN context.
alt: 무상태 웹 서버의 수평 확장과 외부 공유 세션 저장소, 캐시·DB·CDN 구조
requiredChecks: Load balancer sends requests to interchangeable Web A/B/C within Autoscaling group, with no per-node session store.
All web nodes access one external Shared session store, so routing is not tied to a particular node.
Application cache and primary/replica data routes are distinct from session store; replication is Primary→Replica.
Client static content goes to CDN separately; captions and routes readable.
